description.en: Plays a "HQ" high-quality cutscene, built from a sound ID (with a "_<LG>" suffix appended) and a cut number, and waits for it to finish playing.
Base sound/cutscene ID; "_<LG>" is appended to form the actual scene name.
Cut number within the cutscene to play.
Optional; whether to end with a white fade instead of the default (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Play an HQ cutscene ending with a white fade
RunHQEvent("hqev010200", 3, true);
